nodes.description: Address holding privileged ownership of the contract; set to msg.sender at construction and required by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership in the two-step ownership handover.
Public token symbol string, set once in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Public token name string, set once in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Public decimals value of the token, set once in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Internal total supply minted to owner; read by totalSupply() when subtracting the zero-address balance.
Blacklist/blocked recipient address writable by onlyOwner; transfer and transferFrom revert when tokens are sent to it.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom using SafeMath.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
Sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account of the contract.
Only-owner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner then promotes newOwner to owner.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; guards transferOwnership, transfernewun and clearCNDAO.
Initialises symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply and credits the whole amount to owner.
Only-owner setter that overwrites the newun blacklist address.
View returning _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
View returning the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Token transfer that blocks transfers to newun and updates sender/recipient balances via SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Delegate transfer that silently initialises newun = to on the first call, otherwise enforces the newun blacklist, then moves balances and decrements the allowance.
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Writes the allowance for msg.sender and then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract; classic state-write-before-external-call pattern.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers to the base token contract.
Only-owner function that casts msg.sender to payable and transfers the entire contract balance to it.
Empty payable fallback that silently accepts Ether sent to the derived contract.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, allowance owner, balance key, spender and payable recipient of contract funds.
Low-level external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed on an attacker-chosen contract address after state was updated.
Native balance transfer _owner.transfer(address(this).balance) draining the whole contract balance to the msg.sender-derived address.
Candidate new owner passed to transferOwnership and written into newOwner.
New blacklist address passed to transfernewun and stored in newun.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Recipient checked against newun and credited in transfer.
Amount moved from msg.sender to 'to' in transfer.
Spender granted the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount written by approve.
Debited account (with allowance check) of transferFrom.
Credited account of transferFrom, also compared against newun.
Amount moved and subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
Allowance-owner key read in allowance.
Spender key read in allowance.
Address granted the allowance and invoked as the external callback contract.
Allowance amount written by approveAndCall and forwarded to the callee.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded verbatim to the external spender contract.
Local payable address derived from msg.sender that receives the whole contract balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the Owned constructor, granting the deployer privileged rights.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfernewun execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
clearCNDAO execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorise the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner and clears the pending slot.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) is the only authorisation for taking ownership.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
TokenBEP20 constructor uses owner as the initial holder of the whole supply.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the token decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
The _newun parameter flows into the newun state variable.
transfernewun overwrites the newun blacklist used to block transfers.
tokenOwner selects the mapping slot read by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply performs a subtraction on _totalSupply (SafeMath protected).
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend of the supply computation.
'to' is the recipient checked and credited by transfer.
'tokens' is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
msg.sender is the debited balance key and the Transfer event emitter in transfer.
transfer mutates the balances mapping via SafeMath add/sub.
transfer reverts when the recipient equals the blacklisted newun address.
spender is the key of the allowance written by approve.
tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
approve lets msg.sender grant an allowance over its own funds.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without an upper bound.
'from' is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
'to' is the credited account compared against newun in transferFrom.
'tokens' is moved and subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom moves balances between 'from' and 'to' using SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and can under-authorise on the first call path.
transferFrom silently sets newun = to on the first call when newun is empty, otherwise enforces the blacklist.
tokenOwner keys the allowance read.
spender keys the allowance read.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
spender receives the allowance and is used as the callback target in approveAndCall.
tokens is written as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is forwarded verbatim to the arbitrary external callee.
approveAndCall writes an allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approveAndCall updates the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied contract while the allowance has just been updated.
The external callee can re-enter the token contract and re-use the freshly written state.
clearCNDAO casts msg.sender to payable and makes it the sole beneficiary of the balance.
Local _owner is derived from msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.
clearCNDAO executes the balance transfer unsafe operation.
The entire contract balance is sent to the msg.sender-derived address.
